mission_08: React performance optimization prevents unnecessary work. React.memo wraps components to skip re-renders when props have not changed. useMemo caches expensive computations so they only recalculate when dependencies change. useCallback memoizes functions so child components receiving them as props do not re-render. React.lazy with Suspense enables code splitting — loading components only when needed. Virtualization renders only visible items in long lists. These techniques keep your application fast even as data and complexity grow.
